description: Fetch a site's vulnerability-disclosure file (RFC 9116) from /.well-known/security.txt (falling back to /security.txt): the declared security Contact(s), Expires date and whether it has lapsed, PGP Encryption key, Policy/Acknowledgments links, preferred languages, and whether the file is PGP-signed, plus conformance warnings. A read of a public, owner-published file — complements abuse_contact (the RIR's registered mailbox) with the owner's own disclosure channel. Read-only, no probing.
name: security_txt
